title: Traceability Matrix
description: Single source of truth for business rule traceability. Phase 1 populates artifact-level fields (spec_coverage, requirement_id, target_component). Phase 2 enriches each entry in-place with code-level findings (implementation_evidence, logic_verified, test_evidence, implementation_status).

in_scope.description: BRs within plan.json scope — denominator for artifact_coverage_pct.

fully_traced.description: In-scope BRs with both requirement_id and target_component mapped.

partially_traced.description: In-scope BRs with either requirement_id or target_component mapped, but not both.

untraced.description: In-scope BRs with neither requirement_id nor target_component mapped.

artifact_coverage_pct.description: Artifact-level coverage: fully_traced / in_scope * 100. Measures documentation completeness, not code correctness.

entries.description: One entry per in-scope business rule.

summary.description: One-line description from analysis.json. Used in issue messages.

pseudocode.description: Expected business logic from analysis.json. Authoritative reference for logic verification in Phase 2.

requirement_id.description: Mapped FR-### from spec.json traceability[br_id].functional_requirement. null if absent.

target_component.description: Target component responsible for this rule, from spec.json traceability[br_id].component. Tells Phase 2 where to search for implementation. null if absent.

expected_test_areas.description: Test coverage types expected for this BR — derived from functional-requirements.md Section 5 (unit if FR mapped, bdd if CF mapped) with fallback to BR type from analysis.json. Drives targeted test search in Phase 2.

spec_coverage.description: COMPLETE = requirement_id and target_component both mapped. PARTIAL = one mapped. MISSING = neither mapped.

logic_verified.description: Phase 2 — true if implementation matches pseudocode. null when implementation was not found and verification was skipped.

implementation_status.description: Phase 2 — code-level status. IMPLEMENTED = impl found + logic verified + test evidence. PARTIAL = impl or test found but not both. MISSING = no implementation found.

issues.description: Artifact-level issues for this BR entry.

evidence.description: File path with line number or quoted value. Required when available.

out_of_scope_brs.description: BR IDs from analysis.json outside plan.json scope. Not validated.

issues.description: Matrix-level issues that do not belong to any specific BR entry (e.g. Section 8 entirely absent, ambiguous scope warnings).

evidence.description: File path with line number or quoted value. Required when available.
